title: T(ω) as the integral of ⟨ω, ξ⟩ against the weight restricted to a set containing spt ω
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n. Let μ := R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ. Then for every set V ⊆ ℝ^P and every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω ⊆ V, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) d(μ⌞V)(x) (real Bochner integral against the restriction of μ to V).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ (V : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ V → T ω = ∫ x, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂(R.measure.restrict V)
